title: P22: Protocol reserved(0) and undefined values rejected
description: protocol-06 §5 Protocol enum: reserved(0), mls10(1), (255). The draft does not say how to treat reserved or undefined values on decode. Chosen: reject both as unknown values (standard TLS reading), because the select(protocol) that follows cannot be parsed for them.
close_reason: Recorded during mimid-1wgh.5.1; reading chosen as described
